meta.description: Tests gene lists and ranked vectors against live or dated WikiPathways collections with clusterProfiler and rWikiPathways.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All figures are fresh synthetic/live WikiPathways output, with archive release date and public-source behavior stated; no biomedical result was invented.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill performs pathway enrichment on de-identified gene lists and makes no individual diagnostic or treatment claim.

methodological_ground.detail: ORA, ranked GSEA, explicit universes, Entrez matching, live-data drift, dated GMT pinning, and non-human organism validation were each independently exercised.

code_usability.detail: The corrected rWikiPathways standalone accessor, the new non-human API smoke regression, both shipped examples, and every other fresh input completed with exit 0.

functional_suitability.note: ORA, GSEA, dated pinning, direct API inspection, and non-human organism coverage each have an applicable, runnable route.

reliability.note: Explicit ID, universe, archive-retention, and community-curation safeguards now use the correct standalone API namespace.

performance_context.note: Workflow is bounded and linear; dated monthly archive retries make live-data recovery clear.

agent_usability.note: Decision tree, workflow, error prevention, and direct API instructions are explicit and were validated in the declared import context.

human_usability.note: Readable scenario guidance and concise usage guide mitigate necessarily technical pathway content.

security.note: No credentials, destructive actions, or untrusted-code execution are documented; public archive/API traffic is identified.

maintainability.note: The pinned procedure and focused API regression are shipped separately, while the SKILL names the exact supported namespace.

agent_specific.note: Trigger, scope, and escape-hatch language are precise; advanced live-database context remains inherently dense.

inputs.label: Default versus matched ORA universe
inputs.note: The same WP554 query used 17/420 under the matched universe versus 17/9031 by default, changing adjusted p from 4.013e-29 to 2.716e-51.

assertions.note: Both returned WP554.

assertions.text: Background ratio changes materially
assertions.note: 420 mapped tested genes versus 9,031 default genes.

assertions.text: The result demonstrates the documented default-background inflation
assertions.note: Default p.adjust is substantially smaller.

key_strengths: Every advertised live and pinned enrichment route was re-executed in an agent-private runtime at the fixed exact tip.
The source now uses the explicitly namespaced rWikiPathways API and ships a focused standalone non-human regression.
The Skill directly demonstrates the major default-universe inflation hazard and records a reproducible monthly archive release.
